questionSnapshot.question: What special ability does Dumbo discover he has?

notes: Parallel powers, easy. #506 asks which body part enables flight; that is a new anatomical fact beyond naming the ability. #1054 concerns the confidence-giving feather.

options.reason: Dumbo discovers flight using his enormous ears.

sources.locator: Opening synopsis: Dumbo discovers flight using oversized ears with help from his mouse friend Timothy; voice credits name Timothy.

options.reason: The discovered unusual ability is aerial flight, not super strength.
